BrochureContent.Content:
A beautifully presented three bedroom semi detached home with a stunning south facing rear garden, ideally suited to first-time buyers, young families, or anyone looking for a stylish and comfortable home in a convenient location. This gorgeous property has been lovingly maintained and tastefully decorated throughout, offering bright, modern accommodation with a warm and welcoming feel from the moment you step inside. The property opens into a welcoming entrance hall with guest WC, leading to a beautifully decorated sitting room featuring a timber floor, attractive bay window, and a charming open fireplace ? the perfect space to relax and unwind. Double doors open through to the impressive kitchen/dining room, which is the true heart of this home. This spacious area boasts an excellent range of built in units, a central island, and plenty of room for family dining and entertaining. The patio doors flood the room with natural light and open directly onto the standout feature of this property ? the wonderful south-facing rear garden.
The rear garden has been thoughtfully designed to be completely maintenance free, featuring a stylish patio area and artificial grass, making it an ideal outdoor space for children?s play equipment, entertaining, or simply enjoying the sunshine. The garden is cleverly arranged over two levels, with the elevated patio area and pergola creating a private and relaxing retreat ? perfect for enjoying morning coffee, summer evenings, or outdoor gatherings.
Upstairs, the property offers three well proportioned bedrooms, all with built in wardrobes. The master bedroom is particularly impressive, featuring a large slide robe and a private ensuite shower room. The main bathroom is beautifully tiled and tastefully finished, adding to the quality feel throughout the home.
Externally, the property benefits from off street parking to the front, oil fired central heating, and a low maintenance exterior, making it a practical and easy to manage home.
Located on the popular west side of Athlone, Danesfort is ideally positioned close to local amenities, neighbourhood centre, schools, and excellent transport links, with easy access to the motorway network.
This is a fantastic opportunity to purchase a stylish, turn key home in a sought-after location. With its beautiful interiors, superb south facing garden, and excellent location, 8 Danesfort is sure to appeal to first time buyers and those looking to make the move into a wonderful family home.

Outside
The outdoor space is undoubtedly one of the standout features of this exceptional home. The south facing rear garden has been beautifully designed with modern living in mind, offering a private, stylish, and completely low maintenance retreat. Finished with a generous patio area and high quality artificial grass, it provides the perfect setting for children?s play, outdoor dining, summer gatherings, or simply relaxing in the sunshine. The clever split level design adds a wonderful sense of space, with the elevated patio area leading thru a charming pergola leading to the lower level ? an ideal spot to enjoy morning coffee, unwind after a busy day, or entertain friends and family. This beautifully landscaped garden combines practicality with comfort, creating a fantastic outdoor extension of the home that can be enjoyed all year round.

A superb opportunity to acquire this beautifully presented three bedroom semi-detached home located in the popular Danesfort development on the Old Galway Road, Athlone.
No. 8 Danesfort is a wonderful turn key property that has been carefully maintained and stylishly decorated, offering modern living accommodation with a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout. From the moment you enter, the quality and attention to detail are evident.
The accommodation comprises a bright entrance hall with guest WC, an elegant sitting room with timber flooring, feature bay window and open fireplace, and a spacious kitchen/dining room which forms the heart of the home. The kitchen offers an excellent range of fitted units, a central island, and generous dining space, with patio doors opening directly onto the impressive south facing rear garden.
The rear garden is a real highlight of this property. Designed with convenience in mind, it is completely maintenance free with a paved patio area, artificial grass, and a cleverly designed elevated section with pergola, creating a private space to relax and enjoy outdoor living. This garden is perfect for families, children's play areas, or summer entertaining.
Upstairs there are three well appointed bedrooms, all with built in wardrobes. The master bedroom benefits from a large slide robe and ensuite, while the main bathroom is beautifully tiled and finished to a high standard.
Ideally located on the west side of Athlone, Danesfort is within easy reach of local amenities, neighbourhood centre, schools, and the motorway network, making it an ideal choice for first time buyers, young families, or those seeking a stylish and manageable home in a convenient location.
Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, presentation, and superb outdoor space this wonderful home has to offer.

Athlone town centre is just a short drive away, offering an extensive selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, bars, and everyday services, while residents can also enjoy the scenic walks and leisure facilities along the River Shannon and surrounding areas. The property is conveniently located for commuters, with easy access to the motorway network providing excellent connectivity to Galway, Dublin, and beyond. Combining convenience, accessibility, and a strong community atmosphere, this location offers the perfect balance of modern living and everyday practicality.
